gloss: currying favor; flattery; trying to please

definitions.gloss: currying favor; flattery; trying to please someone; buttering up
definitions.explanation: The act of trying to get on someone's good side or put them in a good mood, often through flattery or excessive agreeableness. Can also refer to the person who does this.

examples.japanese: ⟦{上司|じょうし}→上司：03286_joushi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{機嫌取|きげんと}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
{機嫌取|きげんと}り⟦ばかり→〜ばかり：02006_bakari⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{信用|しんよう}されない→信用する：25371_shinyousuru⟧。
examples.english: People who are always trying to curry favor aren't trusted.

examples.japanese: ⟦プレゼント→プレゼント：01791_purezento⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}って→買う：00489_kau⟧きた⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{機嫌取|きげんと}りだ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{見|み}え{見|み}えだった。
examples.english: It was obvious that buying the present was just an attempt to get back in her good graces.

notes: Composed of ⟦{機嫌|きげん}→機嫌：02367_kigen⟧ (mood, humor) + ⟦{取|と}り→取る：00565_toru⟧ (taking, winning). Takes ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: {機嫌取|きげんと}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to try to please someone). Often has a negative connotation, implying insincerity or self-serving motives. Related expressions: ⟦{機嫌|きげん}→機嫌：02367_kigen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧ (to try to please), ⟦{機嫌|きげん}→機嫌：02367_kigen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{伺|うかが}う (to gauge someone's mood — more neutral), ご{機嫌取|きげんと}り (same meaning, slightly more emphatic with the honorific ご). Similar to ⟦{胡麻|ごま}→胡麻：10337_goma⟧⟦すり→すり：01330_suri⟧ (brown-nosing) and ⟦お{世辞|せじ}→お世辞：07023_oseji⟧ (flattery).
